info.title: ENSO Incense API
info.description: Supabase Edge Function contracts. Auto-generated PostgREST table endpoints are documented separately.

post.description: Requires a Supabase user JWT. Product prices and member details are loaded and verified server-side.

200.description: Order created or an idempotent retry returned the existing order.

409.description: The checkout request conflicts with an existing request or current order state.

post.summary: Start a TapPay card or LINE Pay transaction
post.description: Requires a Supabase user JWT. The order owner and amount are verified server-side.

409.description: Order is not payable or its amount could not be verified.

post.summary: Perform an authorized order or after-sales action
post.description: Requires a Supabase user JWT and a role permitted for the requested action. Additional fields depend on action.

200.description: The result object depends on the selected action.

403.description: The current role cannot perform this action.

409.description: The order state does not allow this action.

post.description: Requires a Supabase user JWT and the admin or finance role.

400.description: Invalid adjustment input or adjustment rejected.

403.description: Only admin or finance roles may adjust credit.

post.summary: Process or reconcile delivery notification jobs
post.description: Requires a Supabase user JWT and the finance or admin role.

400.description: Unsupported action or invalid reconciliation input.

403.description: Only finance or admin roles may process jobs.

409.description: The delivery job cannot be reconciled.

post.description: Server-to-server endpoint. Send the configured 64-character token in `x-delivery-cron-token`.

401.description: Cron token is missing or invalid.

409.description: The environment is not configured for simulation.

post.description: Public TapPay server-to-server callback. The notification is verified against TapPay's transaction API before settlement.
